# # This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking # the 'Run App' button above. # # Find out more about building applications with Shiny here: # # https://shiny.posit.co/ # # install.packages("shiny") # install.packages("bslib") # install.packages("dplyr") # install.packages("tidyr") library(shiny) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) downloadButton <- function(...) { tag <- shiny::downloadButton(...) tag$attribs$download <- NULL tag } # Define UI for application ui <- page_navbar( # Color theme theme = bs_theme( bg = "#FFFFFF", fg = "#000000", primary = "#408c3b" ), # Title title = "Decision Analysis to Inform Screening of the Young (DAISY)", header = navset_pill( # Introduction nav_panel("Introduction", card(p("Decision Analysis to Inform Screening of the Young (DAISY) is an interactive tool to support evidence-based newborn screening policy decisions. It is a flexible decision analytic model that projects the impact of newborn screening compared with clinical case identification for a given condition. The model is adaptable to various conditions, screening algorithms, and treatment eligibility criteria, and it allows the user to specify parameter input values that reflect their jurisdiction and are relevant to policymaking. The initial development of this model was supported by funding from the Health Resources and Services Administration as part of a contract to the Evidence Review Group of the Advisory Committee on Heritable Disorders in Newborns and Children. A full description of the model is available as a peer-reviewed journal article.")), sidebarLayout(position = "right", # Main panel mainPanel( card( card_header(strong("Model Assumptions")), card_body( p(HTML( "• Everyone who is eligible for treatment based on genotype and age receives it
• Treatment adherence is 100%
• Newborns with a family history are eligible for early treatment under standard care
• All newborns receive the same standard care regardless of location or health care access
• All newborns within a treatment group (early or late) respond to treatment in the same way
• Deaths unrelated to the condition are not taken into account
")) ), ), card(htmlOutput("IntroductionText")) ), # Side bar panel sidebarPanel( textInput(inputId = "Year", label = "Time horizon for outcome projections (years)", value = "5"), selectInput( inputId = "Timehorizon", label = "When does the time horizon begin?", choices = c("From birth","From symptom onset"), selected = "From symptom onset"), textInput(inputId = "Outcome", label = "Functional outcome measure of interest", value = "GMFM"), numericInput(inputId = "Pop", label = "Population", value = 3600000), numericInput("popPrev", label = "Population prevalance", value = 0.00001, min = 0, max = 0.01), numericInput("pFamHX", label = "Probability of family history", value = 0.32, min = 0, max = 1) ) ), ), # Clinical identification nav_panel("Clinical Identification", sidebarLayout(position = "right", # Main panel mainPanel( card(DT::DTOutput("Clinical")), card(htmlOutput("Clinicaltext")) ), # Side bar panel sidebarPanel( numericInput("pClin", label = "Probability of clinical identification", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pClinFamHX", label = "Probabiliity of clinical identification with family history", value = 1.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pEarlyTxEligClin", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under clinical identification", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pLateTxEligClin", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for late treatment under clinical identification", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under clinical identification with family history", value = 0.87, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pLateTxEligClinFamHX", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for late treatment under clinical identification with family history", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), downloadButton("downloadclinical", "Download")))), # Newborn screening nav_panel("Newborn Screening", sidebarLayout(position = "right", # Main panel mainPanel( card(DT::DTOutput("NBST")), card(htmlOutput("NBtext")) ), # Side bar panel sidebarPanel( card( numericInput("pT1Pos", label = "Probability of a positive Tier 1 screen", value = 0.00049, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("T1Sens", label = "Tier 1 sensitivity", value = 1, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("T1Spec", label = "Tier 1 specificity", value = .99952, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pT1LTFU", label = "Probability of Tier 1 loss to follow up", value = 0.00, min = 0, max = 1)), checkboxInput("Multi", label = "Tick this box if your screening algorithm has two tiers"), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.Multi == true", card( numericInput("pT2Pos", label = "Probability of a positive Tier 2 screen", value = 0.0204, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("T2Sens", label = "Tier 2 sensitvity", value = 1, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("T2Spec", label = "Tier 2 specificity", value = 1.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pT2LTFU", label = "Probability of Tier 2 loss to follow up", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("pEarlyTxEligNBS2", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under two-tier screening", value = 1.0, min = 0, max = 1), downloadButton( "downloadtwotier", "Download"))), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.Multi == false", card( numericInput("pEarlyTxEligNBS1", label = "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under single-tier screening", value = 1.0, min = 0, max = 1), downloadButton( "downloadsingletier", "Download")))))), # Treatment effectiveness nav_panel("Treatment Effectiveness", sidebarLayout(position = "right", # Main panel mainPanel( card(DT::DTOutput("sample2")), card(htmlOutput("text2")) ), # Side bar panel sidebarPanel( card( selectInput("ScreeningStrat", label = "Screening strategy", choices = c("Clinical identification", "Single-tier testing", "Multi-tier testing")), numericInput("survEarlyTx", label = "Survival with early treatment ", value = 0.911, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("survLateTx", label = "Survival with late treatment ", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("survNoTx", label = "Survival without treatment", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("outcomeEarlyTx", label = "Early treatment outcome measure score", value = 0.885, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("outcomeLateTx", label = "Late treatment outcome measure score", value = 0.0, min = 0, max = 1), numericInput("outcomeNoTx", label = "No treatment outcome measure score", value = 0.110, min = 0, max = 1), downloadButton( "downloadtreatment", "Download"))), ), ), ), ) server <- function(input, output, session) { observeEvent(input$Outcome, { updateNumericInput(session,"outcomeEarlyTx", label = paste("Early treatment", input$Outcome, "score")) updateNumericInput(session,"outcomeLateTx", label = paste("Late treatment", input$Outcome, "score")) updateNumericInput(session,"outcomeNoTx", label = paste("No treatment", input$Outcome, "score")) }) # Introduction definitions output$IntroductionText <- renderUI({ p(HTML(paste( "Time horizon for outcome projections (years): The time horizon of the model, in years from birth or years from symptom onset.", "Functional outcome measure of interest: The name of a non-survival clinical or functional outcome measure relevant to the target condition.", "Population: The number of individuals in a birth cohort in the jurisdiction in which screening is being considered.", "Population prevalance: The prevalence at birth of the target condition. If birth prevalence is not known, it can be inferred from the population prevalence of the condition at an age after clinical case detection would have occurred and before individuals would be expected to die from the condition.", "Probability of family history: The probability that a given newborn with the target condition has an older sibling or other family member with the target condition.", sep = "
"))) }) # Clinical identification calculations # Population with the condition popCond <- reactive({input$Pop*input$popPrev}) popCondlower <- reactive({input$Pop*(input$popPrev - (1.96*sqrt((input$popPrev*(1-input$popPrev))/input$Pop)))}) popCondupper <- reactive({input$Pop*(input$popPrev + (1.96*sqrt((input$popPrev*(1-input$popPrev))/input$Pop)))}) # Population identified with the condition under clinical care popCondClin <- reactive({(input$pClin*(popCond()-popCondFamHX()))}) popCondClinlower<- reactive({(input$pClin - (1.96*sqrt(((input$pClin*(1-input$pClin))/(popCond()-popCondFamHX())))))*(popCond()-popCondFamHX())}) popCondClinupper<- reactive({(input$pClin + (1.96*sqrt(((input$pClin*(1-input$pClin))/(popCond()-popCondFamHX())))))*(popCond()-popCondFamHX())}) # Population eligible for early treatment under clinical care popEarlyTxEligClin <- reactive({input$pEarlyTxEligClin*popCondClin()}) popEarlyTxEligClinlower <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligClin - (1.96*sqrt(((input$pEarlyTxEligClin*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligClin))/popCondClin()))))*popCondClin()}) popEarlyTxEligClinupper <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligClin + (1.96*sqrt(((input$pEarlyTxEligClin*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligClin))/popCondClin()))))*popCondClin()}) # Population eligible for late treatment under clinical care popLateTxEligClin<- reactive({(input$pLateTxEligClin)*(popCondClin()-popEarlyTxEligClin())}) popLateTxEligClinlower<- reactive({(input$pLateTxEligClin - (1.96*sqrt(((input$pLateTxEligClin*(1-input$pLateTxEligClin))/(popCondClin()-popEarlyTxEligClin())))))*(popCondClin()-popEarlyTxEligClin())}) popLateTxEligClinupper<- reactive({(input$pLateTxEligClin + (1.96*sqrt(((input$pLateTxEligClin*(1-input$pLateTxEligClin))/(popCondClin()-popEarlyTxEligClin())))))*(popCondClin()-popEarlyTxEligClin())}) # Family history calculations # Population with the condition with a family history of the condition # (assumes family history leads to diagnosis under clinical identification) popCondFamHX<- reactive({input$pFamHX*popCond()}) popCondFamHXlower<- reactive({popCond()*(input$pFamHX - (1.96*sqrt((input$pFamHX*(1-input$pFamHX))/popCond())))}) popCondFamHXupper<- reactive({popCond()*(input$pFamHX + (1.96*sqrt((input$pFamHX*(1-input$pFamHX))/popCond())))}) # Population with a family history identified under clinical care popCondFamHXClin <- reactive({input$pClinFamHX * popCondFamHX()}) popCondFamHXClinlower <- reactive({(input$pClinFamHX - (1.96*sqrt((input$pClinFamHX*(1-input$pClinFamHX))/popCondFamHX())))* popCondFamHX()}) popCondFamHXClinupper <- reactive({(input$pClinFamHX + (1.96*sqrt((input$pClinFamHX*(1-input$pClinFamHX))/popCondFamHX())))* popCondFamHX()}) # Population with a family history eligible for early treatment under clinical care popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin <- reactive({input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX * popCondFamHXClin()}) popEarlyTxEligFamHXClinlower <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX - (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX))/popCondFamHXClin())))* popCondFamHXClin()}) popEarlyTxEligFamHXClinupper <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX + (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligClinFamHX))/popCondFamHXClin())))* popCondFamHXClin()}) # Population with a family history eligible for late treatment under clinical care popLateTxEligFamHXClin <- reactive({(input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX)* (popCondFamHXClin()-popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin())}) popLateTxEligFamHXClinlower <- reactive({input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX - (1.96*sqrt((input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX*(1-input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX))/(popCondFamHXClin()-popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin())))* (popCondFamHXClin()-popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin())}) popLateTxEligFamHXClinupper <- reactive({input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX + (1.96*sqrt((input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX*(1-input$pLateTxEligClinFamHX))/(popCondFamHXClin()-popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin())))* (popCondFamHXClin()-popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin())}) # Clinical identification table ClinicalIDtable<- reactive({ data.frame(c(popCond(), popCondFamHX(), popCondClin(), popCondFamHXClin(), popEarlyTxEligClin(), popLateTxEligClin(), popEarlyTxEligFamHXClin(), popLateTxEligFamHXClin()), c(popCondlower(), popCondFamHXlower(), popCondClinlower(), popCondFamHXClinlower(), popEarlyTxEligClinlower(), popLateTxEligClinlower(), popEarlyTxEligFamHXClinlower(), popLateTxEligFamHXClinlower()), c(popCondupper(), popCondFamHXupper(), popCondClinupper(), popCondFamHXClinupper(), popEarlyTxEligClinupper(), popLateTxEligClinupper(), popEarlyTxEligFamHXClinupper(), popLateTxEligFamHXClinupper()), row.names = c("Population with condition", "Population with condition and family history", "Diagnosed under clinical identification", "Diagnosed under clinical identification with family history", "Eligible for early treatment after clinical identification", "Eligible for late treatment after clinical idenification", "Eligible for early treatment after clinical identification with family history", "Eligible for late treatment after clinical identification with family history")) %>% rename(Estimate = c.popCond....popCondFamHX....popCondClin....popCondFamHXClin....) %>% rename("95% CI (lower bound)" = c.popCondlower....popCondFamHXlower....popCondClinlower....popCondFamHXClinlower....) %>% rename("95% CI (Upper bound)"= c.popCondupper....popCondFamHXupper....popCondClinupper....popCondFamHXClinupper....) }) output$Clinical <- DT::renderDT({round(ClinicalIDtable(), digits = 2)}) output$downloadclinical <- downloadHandler( filename = function() { paste("Clincal identification screening", ".csv", sep = "") }, content = function(file) { write.csv(round(ClinicalIDtable(),2), file, row.names = TRUE) } ) # Clinical identification definitions output$Clinicaltext <- renderUI({ p(HTML(paste( "Probability of clinical identification: Probability that an individual is diagnosed with the target condition via routine clinical care.", "Probability of clinical identification with family history: Probability that an individual is diagnosed with the target condition via routine clinical care given that they have a family history of the target condition.", "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under clinical identification: Proportion of individuals who are diagnosed via routine clinical care who are eligible for early treatment, given treatment eligibility considerations such as genotype or age.", "Proportion of individuals eligible for late treatment under clinical identification: Proportion of individuals who are diagnosed via routine clinical care who are eligible for late treatment, given treatment eligibility considerations such as genotype or age.", "Proportion of individuals eligible for early treatment under clinical identification with family history: Proportion of individuals with a family history who are diagnosed via routine clinical care who are eligible for early treatment, given treatment eligibility considerations such as genotype or age.", "Proportion of individuals eligible for late treatment under clinical identification with family history: Proportion of individuals with a family history who are diagnosed via routine clinical care who are eligible for late treatment, given treatment eligibility considerations such as genotype or age.", sep = "
"))) }) # Newborn screening calculations # Tier 1 # Number of positive Tier 1 screens popT1Pos <- reactive({input$Pop*input$pT1Pos}) popT1Poslower <- reactive({input$Pop*(input$pT1Pos - (1.96*sqrt((input$pT1Pos*(1-input$pT1Pos))/input$Pop)))}) popT1Posupper <- reactive({input$Pop*(input$pT1Pos + (1.96*sqrt((input$pT1Pos*(1-input$pT1Pos))/input$Pop)))}) # Number of true positive Tier 1 screens popT1TruePos <- reactive({popCond()*(input$T1Sens)}) popT1TruePoslower <- reactive({popCond()*(input$T1Sens - (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Sens*(1-input$T1Sens))/popCond())))}) popT1TruePosupper <- reactive({popCond()*(input$T1Sens + (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Sens*(1-input$T1Sens))/popCond())))}) # Number of true negative Tier 1 screens popT1TrueNeg <- reactive({((input$Pop*(1-input$popPrev))*input$T1Spec)}) popT1TrueNeglower <- reactive({((input$Pop*((1-input$popPrev) - (1.96*sqrt((1-input$popPrev*(1-(1-input$popPrev)))/(input$Pop)))))*(input$T1Spec - (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Spec*(1-input$T1Spec))/input$Pop))))}) popT1TrueNegupper <- reactive({((input$Pop*((1-input$popPrev) + (1.96*sqrt((1-input$popPrev*(1-(1-input$popPrev)))/(input$Pop)))))*(input$T1Spec + (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Spec*(1-input$T1Spec))/input$Pop))))}) # Number of false negative Tier 1 screens popT1FalseNeg <- reactive({popCond()*(1-input$T1Sens)}) popT1FalseNeglower <- reactive({popCond()*((1-input$T1Sens) - (1.96*sqrt((((1-input$T1Sens)*(1-(1-input$T1Sens)))/(popCond())))))}) popT1FalseNegupper <- reactive({popCond()*((1-input$T1Sens) + (1.96*sqrt((((1-input$T1Sens)*(1-(1-input$T1Sens)))/(popCond())))))}) # Number of false positive Tier 1 screens popT1FalsePos <- reactive({(input$Pop*(1-input$popPrev)*(1-input$T1Spec))}) popT1FalsePoslower <- reactive({(input$Pop*((1-input$popPrev) - (1.96*sqrt((1-input$popPrev*(1-(1-input$popPrev)))/(input$Pop))))*((1-input$T1Spec) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T1Spec)*(1-(1-input$T1Spec)))/(input$Pop)))))}) popT1FalsePosupper <- reactive({(input$Pop*((1-input$popPrev) + (1.96*sqrt((1-input$popPrev*(1-(1-input$popPrev)))/(input$Pop))))*((1-input$T1Spec) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T1Spec)*(1-(1-input$T1Spec)))/(input$Pop)))))}) # Number of Tier 1 positives lost to follow up popT1LTFU <- reactive({(popT1Pos()*input$T1Sens)*input$pT1LTFU}) popT1LTFUlower <- reactive({(popT1Pos()*(input$T1Sens - (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Sens*(1-input$T1Sens))/popT1Pos()))))*(input$pT1LTFU - 1.96*sqrt((input$pT1LTFU*(1-input$pT1LTFU))/popT1Pos()))}) popT1LTFUupper <- reactive({(popT1Pos()*(input$T1Sens + (1.96*sqrt((input$T1Sens*(1-input$T1Sens))/popT1Pos()))))*(input$pT1LTFU + 1.96*sqrt((input$pT1LTFU*(1-input$pT1LTFU))/popT1Pos()))}) # Population eligible for early treatment under single-tier testing popEarlyTxEligT1 <- reactive({input$pEarlyTxEligNBS1*popT1TruePos()}) # Question: should LTFU be inputted here to account for proportional loss to follow up popEarlyTxEligT1lower <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligNBS1 - (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligNBS1*(1-input$T1Sens))/popT1TruePos())))*popT1TruePos()}) popEarlyTxEligT1upper <- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligNBS1 + (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligNBS1*(1-input$T1Sens))/popT1TruePos())))*popT1TruePos()}) # Tier 2 # Number of positive Tier 2 screens popT2Pos <- reactive({((popT1TruePos()*input$T2Sens)*(1-input$pT1LTFU))+((popT1FalsePos())*(1-input$T2Sens))}) popT2Poslower <- reactive({((popT1TruePos()*(input$T2Sens - (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Sens*(1-input$T2Sens))/popT1TruePos()))))*((1-input$pT1LTFU) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$pT1LTFU))*(1-(1-input$pT1LTFU))/(popT1TruePos())))))+((popT1FalsePos())*((1-input$T2Sens) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Sens))*(1-(1-input$T2Sens))/(popT1FalsePos())))))}) popT2Posupper <- reactive({((popT1TruePos()*(input$T2Sens + (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Sens*(1-input$T2Sens))/popT1TruePos()))))*((1-input$pT1LTFU) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$pT1LTFU))*(1-(1-input$pT1LTFU))/(popT1TruePos())))))+((popT1FalsePos())*((1-input$T2Sens) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Sens))*(1-(1-input$T2Sens))/(popT1FalsePos())))))}) # Number of true positive Tier 2 screens popT2TruePos <-reactive({(popT1TruePos()*input$T2Sens)*(1-input$pT1LTFU)}) popT2TruePoslower <-reactive({(popT1TruePos()*(input$T2Sens - (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Sens*(1-input$T2Sens))/popT1TruePos()))))*((1-input$pT1LTFU) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$pT1LTFU))*(1-(1-input$pT1LTFU))/(popT1TruePos()))))}) popT2TruePosupper <-reactive({(popT1TruePos()*(input$T2Sens + (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Sens*(1-input$T2Sens))/popT1TruePos()))))*((1-input$pT1LTFU) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$pT1LTFU))*(1-(1-input$pT1LTFU))/(popT1TruePos()))))}) # Number of true negative Tier 2 screens popT2TrueNeg <- reactive({(popT1Pos()-popT1TruePos())*input$T2Spec}) popT2TrueNeglower <- reactive({(popT1Pos()-popT1TruePos())*(input$T2Spec - (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Spec*(1-input$T2Spec))/(popT1Pos()-popT1TruePos()))))}) popT2TrueNegupper <- reactive({(popT1Pos()-popT1TruePos())*(input$T2Spec + (1.96*sqrt((input$T2Spec*(1-input$T2Spec))/(popT1Pos()-popT1TruePos()))))}) # Number of false negative Tier 2 screens popT2FalseNeg <- reactive({(popT1TruePos())*(1-input$T2Spec)}) popT2FalseNeglower <- reactive({(popT1TruePos())*((1-input$T2Spec) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Spec))*(1-(1-input$T2Spec))/(popT1TruePos()))))}) popT2FalseNegupper <- reactive({(popT1TruePos())*((1-input$T2Spec) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Spec))*(1-(1-input$T2Spec))/(popT1TruePos()))))}) # Number of false positive Tier 2 screens popT2FalsePos <- reactive({(popT1FalsePos())*(1-input$T2Sens)}) popT2FalsePoslower <- reactive({(popT1FalsePos())*((1-input$T2Sens) - (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Sens))*(1-(1-input$T2Sens))/(popT1FalsePos()))))}) popT2FalsePosupper <- reactive({(popT1FalsePos())*((1-input$T2Sens) + (1.96*sqrt(((1-input$T2Sens))*(1-(1-input$T2Sens))/(popT1FalsePos()))))}) # Number of Tier 2 positives lost to follow up popT2LTFU <- reactive({popT2TruePos()*input$pT2LTFU}) popT2LTFUlower <- reactive({popT2TruePos()*(input$pT2LTFU - (1.96*sqrt((input$pT2LTFU*(1-input$pT2LTFU))/popT2TruePos())))}) popT2LTFUupper <- reactive({popT2TruePos()*(input$pT2LTFU + (1.96*sqrt((input$pT2LTFU*(1-input$pT2LTFU))/popT2TruePos())))}) # Population eligible for early treatment under Multi-tier testing popEarlyTxEligT2<- reactive({input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2*(popT2TruePos()- popT2LTFU())}) popEarlyTxEligT2lower<- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2 - (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2))/(popT2TruePos()- popT2LTFU()))))*(popT2TruePos()- popT2LTFU())}) popEarlyTxEligT2upper<- reactive({(input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2 + (1.96*sqrt((input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2*(1-input$pEarlyTxEligNBS2))/(popT2TruePos()- popT2LTFU()))))*(popT2TruePos()- popT2LTFU())}) # Newborn screening table # Single tier screening algorithm table totalT1 <- reactive({ data.frame(c(popCond(), popCondFamHX(), popT1Pos(), popT1TruePos(), popT1TrueNeg(), popT1FalsePos(), popT1FalseNeg(), popT1LTFU(), popEarlyTxEligT1()), c(popCondlower(), popCondFamHXlower(), popT1Poslower(), popT1TruePoslower(), popT1TrueNeglower(), popT1FalsePoslower(), popT1FalseNeglower(), popT1LTFUlower(), popEarlyTxEligT1lower()), c(popCondupper(), popCondFamHXupper(), popT1Posupper(), popT1TruePosupper(), popT1TrueNegupper(), popT1FalsePosupper(), rename("95% CI (upper bound)"= c.popCondupper....popCondFamHXupper....popT1Posupper....popT1TruePosupper....) }) # Multi-tier screening algorithm table totalT2 <- reactive({ data.frame(c(popCond(),
